text:
ravi_pm: Draft of company-level OKRs for FY26 Q2 is up. Putting this in the channel for a quick redline pass and exec signoff. TL;DR: three objectives, KRs outlined. Need to resolve scope on two product bets and finalize launch criteria. Please drop redlines by EOD PT.

alex_prod: skimmed. major call is whether we commit to Offline Cache (dedicated) + Streaming Improvements in same quarter. engineering capacity looks tight.

sam_eng: +1 capacity concerns. Offline Cache needs kernel work + perf validation. Streaming has infra dependencies (routing, KV changes). If we do both we risk pushing rollout.

elaine_cs: customers on SOC2+ contracts are explicitly asking for private deploy and predictable latencies. From CS priority calls: Private infra + SLA > streaming features for Q2.

tony_sales: to echo — top three ARR motions this quarter tied to Dedicated/Private. If we deprioritize private, deal risk increases.

maria_ceo: thanks — this is the tradeoff. I want to see a clear launch criteria table and an ask: what can we safely commit to without jeopardizing revenue motions?

ravi_pm: fair. proposed compromise: prioritize Private (Private control plane + minimal on-prem packaging) as the flagship Q2 deliverable; move Streaming Improvements to Q3. Offline Cache becomes a post-launch Q2 patch if we find spare cycles.

alex_prod: that seems reasonable but we need a measurable KR for "Private" beyond "deliver". propose: KR1 = "Private GA with 3 pilot customers and <2% rollout error rate". Also include performance KR: "95p latency <200ms on README workload".

sam_eng: performance KR is OK but 200ms might be optimistic for initial GA on smaller GPUs. suggest 95p <350ms for GA, then target 200ms by Q3.

elaine_cs: pilot customer commitments look feasible — we have 2 enterprise pilots verbal and 1 in negotiation. I can move one to signed pilot by end of month if we commit.

ton.y_sales: +1 for signed pilot sooner. also request a revenue KR: "$X ARR pipeline attributable to Private by EOM Q2".

maria_ceo: revenue KR should be framed as pipeline/closed — pick one. prefer pipeline for Q2. specify number: $750k pipeline for Private.

ravi_pm: capturing redlines — updating doc:
```
Objective A: Make Redwood the inference platform of choice for regulated workloads
KR A1: Private GA with 3 pilots (>=1 signed)
KR A2: 95p p99 latency <=350ms (GA)
KR A3: $750k pipeline attributable to Private by EOM Q2

Objective B: Improve inference economics and reliability
KR B1: Reduce per-1M-token cost by 15% via batching/quant profiles
KR B2: Deploy canary rollout system with automatic fallback by GA

Objective C: Developer velocity & adoption
KR C1: 30% increase in active routes using new SDKs
KR C2: shipping two reference apps for Dedicated/Demo
```

alex_prod: looks cleaner. For B1 we should call out measurement method (cost per 1M tokens at 95%ile load). add that so it's measurable.

sam_eng: rollout system KR needs an owner and SLOs. suggest: owner = eng-runtime, SLO = no more than 1% failed requests during canary, rollback within 5m.

elaine_cs: can we add a QA gate for customer-facing GA: security review + signed pilot? otherwise we'll get support churn.

ravi_pm: noted. adding GA checklist item: security review complete, 1 signed pilot, CS playbook ready, 90d SLA doc.

maria_ceo: I want a brief tradeoff note in the doc that explains the decision to push Streaming to Q3 and the revenue/ops rationale. Keep it 2-3 bullets.

ravi_pm: will add. also will surface a minimized scope plan for Offline Cache if we get extra capacity.

deploy-bot: Document updated: https://docs.internal/redwood/okrs/q2-fy26 (edited by ravi_pm)

tony_sales: quick asks for doc: add "sales enablement" KR under Developer velocity or a dependency note. need 2 enablement webinars + one battlecard by GA.

ravi_pm: adding Sales enablement KR under Objective C: "2 enablement webinars + 1 battlecard by GA".

alex_prod: final check — are we happy with the target numbers? If so I'll mark this as exec-ready and request signoff.

maria_ceo: overall signoff pending two small edits: (1) change latency target wording to GA baseline at 95p <350ms, (2) include pipeline metric source (CRM pipeline attribution tag). After those edits, sign me off. :white_check_mark:

ravi_pm: thanks — making those edits now. I'll re-post in 30m with final doc and a single approval reaction ask.

elaine_cs: great — happy to sync with PMs to lock pilot commitments.

sam_eng: will prepare the runtime owners list and ensure eng-runtime can cover canary SLOs.

tony_sales: will line up enablement dates with field motion.

alex_prod: thanks team. once ravi posts final I'll add :thumbsup: or :no_entry_sign: in-thread for quick tally.

ravi_pm: final doc posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/okrs/q2-fy26-final (edited). requesting final approvals — please react with :thumbsup: to approve or :pencil2: if you want to propose a small edit. Deadline for signoff: EOD PT today.

maria_ceo: :thumbsup: (signoff)

elaine_cs: :thumbsup:
